assessment.nobel_worthiness: A foundational physiological discovery translated into exceptionally consequential therapies for diabetes and obesity.
assessment.attribution: These three provide a coherent attribution spanning identification of GLP-1 physiology, peptide biology, and its physiological and therapeutic development.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism and clinical impact are extensively established across large patient populations.
uncertainties: The complete attribution for drug-development advances is broader than three individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing created a powerful, clinically validated route to altering a devastating inherited disease.
assessment.attribution: Krainer and Bennett represent the central mechanistic and therapeutic-development contributions specified by the candidate.
assessment.maturity: Its molecular rationale and durable clinical translation are well established.
uncertainties: Long-term outcome differences among treated populations remain important to characterize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like-particle HPV vaccines are a landmark preventive intervention against infection-associated cancers.
assessment.attribution: Frazer, Lowy, and Schiller form a readily intelligible group for the underlying vaccine concept and its development.
assessment.maturity: Vaccines have broad real-world use and strong evidence of prevention of HPV infection and related disease.
uncertainties: The respective contributions to the experimental path and commercial translation encompass additional investigators.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition established a defining paradigm for molecularly targeted cancer treatment.
assessment.attribution: The proposed group captures therapeutic development, clinical demonstration, and subsequent mechanistic clinical leadership.
assessment.maturity: The causal target and therapeutic benefit have been convincingly validated over decades.
uncertainties: Credit for discovery of the disease-driving fusion and for the therapeutic program extends beyond this limited group.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: VEGF biology revealed a central regulator of angiogenesis and enabled effective treatment of pathological vascular growth.
assessment.attribution: Ferrara, Dvorak, and Senger are an interpretable group for discovery and biological definition of the pathway.
assessment.maturity: The pathway is deeply replicated and its inhibition has major clinical applications.
uncertainties: The balance of credit between initial vascular-permeability work, VEGF identification, and therapeutic translation is difficult to delimit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Modern multichannel cochlear implants restored meaningful auditory communication for many people and united physiology with engineering.
assessment.attribution: Clark, Hochmair, and Wilson represent complementary central contributions to implantation technology and speech-processing strategies.
assessment.maturity: Clinical benefit and continued worldwide use provide unusually mature validation.
uncertainties: The invention and refinement involved numerous overlapping clinical and engineering contributions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The identification of distinct B- and T-cell lineages transformed the conceptual basis of adaptive immunity.
assessment.attribution: Miller and Cooper are a compact and appropriate pair for the linked lineage discoveries.
assessment.maturity: The framework is foundational, repeatedly confirmed, and central to modern immunology and medicine.
uncertainties: The historical experimental record includes important associated contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted folding established a fundamental mechanism by which cells achieve productive protein folding.
assessment.attribution: Hartl and Horwich provide clear, complementary attribution for the decisive chaperonin-folding work.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism is long established and influential across molecular biology and disease research.
uncertainties: Its direct clinical impact is less discrete than for several translational candidates.
